headline: Airbnb shares gain as investors cheer revenue forecast raise, AI payoff
summary: Airbnb shares rose 9% in premarket trading on Friday as the vacation-rental firm's raised annual revenue forecast eased worries over the ‌fallout on global travel demand from the conflict in the Middle East.  As ‌the war in Iran enters its sixth month, hotel operators and online travel agencies are banking on steady ​leisure demand and a host of upcoming international sporting events to help offset any likely impact.  "Despite the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, we continue to see strong underlying demand globally," said finance chief Elinor Mertz on Thursday, adding that the company did not assume any ‌significant impact in its current ⁠quarter.

headline: Airbnb Stock Rallies On Earnings Beat. AI Paying Off, Says CEO.
summary: Airbnb stock leaped Friday after the online vacation rental platform posted second-quarter results ahead of estimates and offered a strong forecast for the September quarter.  Airbnb said late Thursday that it earned $1.37 per share for the June-ended quarter, up 33% from a year earlier.  Sales increased 17% to $3.61 billion, compared with analyst estimates of $3.58 billion.

headline: Airbnb hits four-year high as investors cheer revenue forecast raise, AI payoff
summary: Airbnb shares surged 14% to a more-than-four-year high on Friday as the vacation-rental firm's raised annual revenue forecast eased worries over the ‌fallout on global travel demand from the conflict in the Middle East.  As the war ‌in Iran enters its sixth month, hotel operators and online travel agencies are banking on steady leisure demand and ​a host of upcoming international sporting events to help offset any likely impact.  Meanwhile, Airbnb also highlighted its success ⁠in using AI tools after the rise of the technology had sparked fears of disruptions to traditional travel firms.
